card.line: The Desert of Sin was a wilderness region between Elim and Sinai where Israel camped after leaving Egypt and where God first provided bread from heaven.

moments.title: Israel arrives in Sin
moments.text: On the fifteenth day of the second month after leaving Egypt, Israel set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, between Elim and Sinai.

moments.title: The people grumble
moments.text: In the desert the whole congregation grumbled against Moses and Aaron. They said they missed the pots of meat and bread in Egypt and feared they would starve.

moments.title: God promises bread from heaven
moments.text: The LORD said He would rain down bread from heaven. The people were to gather enough for each day, and twice as much on the sixth day.

moments.title: Israel leaves Sin
moments.text: The people left the Desert of Sin as the LORD commanded and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water to drink.
